title: Emit durable terminal events from the stored result
entry: DurableResourcePool deliver-before-resolve path on real PG/redb, killed after Failed delivery and before dead-letter/ack

title: Settle accepted work when a spawner discards its future
entry: ResourcePool::submit/launch with a legal Spawn implementation that discards supervise without polling, followed by shutdown_with
oracle: Discarding an unpolled supervise future produces one documented Failed/Cancelled terminal outcome and mailbox result where configured, releases units and settles the ledger; shutdown does not wait out its deadline for the discarded task. A normal spawner still completes once.
negative: Constructing the settlement guard only inside the unpolled async body must fail the task-outcome/ledger oracle.
design: Establish ownership/settlement before handing the future to Spawn. Preserve panic containment and avoid duplicate terminal reporting. Do not claim durable execution for an in-memory ResourcePool.
safety: No new dependency from core to an async runtime; preserve capacity and shutdown ordering.

design: Use the existing Dispatcher::check_capacity contract on first observation; persist or emit a terminal reason appropriate to the adapter, without silently dropping entries or looping forever.
safety: Keep one dispatcher owner; distinguish impossible total/kind cost from temporary lack of free capacity.
